name: FrenchModelVariant469_HandleRequest
evidence: matching french_model_variant/variant469_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4; for a non-negative request it selects the configuration record at data + 0xFC indexed by the request and packs four texture images, otherwise it runs one frame and calls the quad-ring, arcs and five-sheet helpers behind their elapsed/phase gates; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md, notes/overlays/french-model-variant469-entry.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the US and Japanese header-452 images build the same source through model_variant/variant452_entry.c, which selects CLUT x 512 instead of 640, and bind the data block 0x28 lower. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
